messages.content: I don’t know your name yet. You haven’t shared it in this chat. If you tell me, I’ll use it. You can also give me a nickname you’d prefer. If your platform supports it, you can say “remember my name is [Name]” and I’ll try to keep using it for this session.

Nice to meet you, Sush. I’ll refer to you as Sush for the rest of this chat. If you want me to remember it for future chats, tell me or use your platform’s memory features. Would you like a nickname or any other way you’d prefer to be addressed?
